title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #1

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surahs? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surahs to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surahs has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surahs.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on brushing teeth? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on brushing teeth.
   B. Use Hadith on brushing teeth to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on brushing teeth has no place in daily life.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character.? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character..
   B. Say Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Fitness? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Fitness.
   C. Use Hadith on Fitness to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Fitness has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara Types of Najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Twahara Types of Najasaat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara Types of Najasaat.
   D. Say Twahara Types of Najasaat has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Conditions for Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Conditions for Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Conditions for Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Conditions for Swalah.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels Atid,? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels Atid,.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Belief in Angels Atid, to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in Angels Atid, has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Etiquette of Eating to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Etiquette of Eating.
   D. Say Hadith on Etiquette of Eating has no place in daily life.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Twahara Types of Najasaat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Wudhu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conditions for Swalah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Surahs with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on brushing teeth with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith of Prophet Muhammad as a model of good character. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Fitness with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Twahara Types of Najasaat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Conditions for Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels Atid, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. B — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Etiquette of Eating with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Prophets mentioned in the Qur’an Virtues of the Prophets (patience, honesty, tru; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Twahara Types of Najasaat; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Wudhu; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Conditions for Swalah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
